record.title: Publish taskctl as public Apache-2.0 software
record.intent: Make the canonical taskctl repository and existing releases publicly usable under Apache-2.0, with anonymous consumer verification.
requirements: Own brule-io/taskctl visibility, current onboarding documentation, native task record and publication evidence. Preserve release artifact digests and historical provenance.
Only taskctl becomes public. Fantastikt and other source repositories retain their visibility.
Check Git history and retained CI logs for credentials before public exposure; inspect scanner findings.
acceptance: GitHub reports brule-io/taskctl public and Apache-2.0; current quick starts require no GitHub credential.
Anonymous release acquisition passes digest checks and pinned native commands; cached execution works offline.
Fantastikt main verification succeeds using the existing pin and workflow without adding a cross-repository secret.
